mcp.addFile.message.defaultMessage: Adds {file} to the workspace (.hive/mcp){files, plural, =0 {} one {, with its file in a folder of its own} other {, with its # files in a folder of its own}}, turned off. Turn it on in the MCP view to choose the projects it runs in. It runs:
mcp.addFile.message.description: Add MCP Server from File, above the command the server runs. {file} is the file added; {files} how many files a .zip brings. Keep .hive/mcp as it is.

mcp.addFile.replaceDetail.defaultMessage: Replace moves it (and the folder of one added from a .zip) to the Recycle Bin and adds this one, turned off: projects that had the old one on lose it. Or choose another name.
mcp.addFile.replaceDetail.description: When a server of that name exists, under Replace or Choose Another Name.

mcp.enable.all.description: The MCP server enable dialog: a button that ticks every project.

mcp.enable.confirmButton.description: Button: turns the MCP server on in the workspace and the projects ticked.

mcp.enable.confirmMessage.defaultMessage: New sessions in the projects you tick start it. It runs:
mcp.enable.confirmMessage.description: The confirmation before an MCP server is turned on in the workspace, above the command it runs and the projects to tick.

mcp.enable.confirmTitle.description: Title of the confirmation before an MCP server is turned on in the workspace. {name} is the server.

mcp.enable.noProjects.defaultMessage: The workspace has no projects yet: turn it on in a project's MCP tab once there is one.
mcp.enable.noProjects.description: The MCP server enable dialog when the workspace has no projects to choose.

mcp.enable.none.description: The MCP server enable dialog: a button that unticks every project.

mcp.enable.projects.description: The MCP server enable dialog: the label above the projects to tick.

mcp.enable.projectsLabel.defaultMessage: Projects to turn it on in
mcp.enable.projectsLabel.description: Accessible name of the list of projects to tick in the MCP server enable dialog.

mcp.error.invalidName.description: An error: an MCP server name Hive refuses.

mcp.error.noServer.defaultMessage: The workspace has no MCP server named {name}.
mcp.error.noServer.description: An error turning a server on in a project. {name} is its name.

mcp.import.changed.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {{names} changed in the project's config after you saw it, so it was copied turned off: check what it runs and turn it on with its switch in the MCP view.} other {{names} changed in the project's config after you saw them, so they were copied turned off: check what they run and turn them on with their switches in the MCP view.}}
mcp.import.changed.description: After Copy to workspace, when servers changed between the confirmation and the copy. {names} lists them, {count} how many.

mcp.import.confirmButton.description: Button: copies the project's MCP servers to the workspace and turns them on in the project.

mcp.import.confirmMessage.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {It is turned on in {project} straight away; other projects can turn it on in their MCP tab. It runs:} other {They are turned on in {project} straight away; other projects can turn them on in their MCP tab. They run:}}
mcp.import.confirmMessage.description: Copy to workspace's confirmation, above what the servers run. {count} is how many; {project} the project they come from.

mcp.import.confirmTitle.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Copy {name} to the workspace?} other {Copy # MCP servers to the workspace?}}
mcp.import.confirmTitle.description: Title of Copy to workspace's confirmation. {count} servers a project defines in its own config; {name} the one when there is one.

mcp.import.on.description: After Copy to workspace: where the copied servers are on.

mcp.import.readFailed.description: An error's title: reading the MCP servers a project defines in its own config failed.

mcp.list.allOffTip.defaultMessage: Off in the workspace: it runs nowhere. Click to turn it on and choose the projects it runs in.
mcp.list.allOffTip.description: The tooltip of a server's switch in the MCP view while it is off in the workspace.

mcp.list.allOnTip.defaultMessage: On in the workspace: it runs in the projects that have it on (new sessions). Click to turn it off everywhere; the projects keep their choices for when it is on again.
mcp.list.allOnTip.description: The tooltip of a server's switch in the MCP view while it is on in the workspace.

mcp.list.allSwitch.description: A server's switch in the MCP view, for screen readers. {name} is the server.

mcp.project.updateFailed.description: An error's title: turning an MCP server on or off in a project failed.

mcp.tab.hint.defaultMessage: Every MCP server in the workspace is available here: turn on the ones this project's agents need. A server runs here only while it is on in the workspace too (its switch in the MCP view).
mcp.tab.hint.description: Under Workspace MCP servers in a project's MCP tab.

mcp.tab.projectDefined.defaultMessage: These servers are in the project's own agent config (such as .mcp.json). Hive starts sessions with only workspace servers, so they stay disabled until copied to the workspace, which turns them on here.
mcp.tab.projectDefined.description: Under Defined by the project in a project's MCP tab. Keep .mcp.json as it is.

mcp.tab.switch.description: A server's switch in a project's MCP tab, for screen readers. {name} is the server, {project} the project.

mcp.tab.workspaceBadge.description: A badge on a server in a project's MCP tab: it is one of the workspace's servers.

mcp.view.allProjects.description: Beside the switch in an MCP server's view that turns it on or off in the workspace (on: it runs in the projects that have it on).

mcp.where.none.description: Where an MCP server is on, under it in the MCP view: on in the workspace, but no project has it on.

mcp.where.off.description: Where an MCP server is on, under it in the MCP view, and beside a project's switch for it in its MCP tab: the workspace has it off, so it runs in no project.

mcp.where.some.description: Where an MCP server is on, under it in the MCP view. {projects} lists the projects.
